title: BOSS DR12 historical estimator and mock-population ancestry

scopes.title: Pre-reconstruction method, population roles and historical code identity
scopes.checked_claim: Original Sec 2–3 describes weighted galaxy/random catalogues, distinct power/bispectrum normalizers, a closed-triangle bispectrum monopole estimator, varying-LOS power multipoles, FFT/bin choices and area-weighted caps. The analysis uses a fixed fiducial cosmology distinct from mock-generating cosmologies. Its 2048 MD-Patchy realizations support covariance/model checks; 1000 QPM realizations test fibre-collision effects; 20 periodic halo catalogues test models without survey selection. Sec 5.3–6.2 locates AP transformations, an approximate bispectrum window, P0/P2/B0 auto/cross covariance and a conditioned Gaussian-fit assumption. Sec 8.4/Appendix C describes dependent compressed RSD/BAO products. The current author Codes page retrospectively associates RUSTICO with the 2016 paper; that link does not identify the actual historical code version.
scopes.unresolved: Exact contemporaneous code/parameter/build/output provenance, historical randoms/masks/windows, discrete bin/triangle ownership, shot-noise/Fourier normalization and complete likelihood/covariance assets are unverified. Current RUSTICO/BRASS snapshots and released filename suffixes do not establish historical 2016/2017 implementation, paired realizations or reconstruction identity. A verified adapter and matching physical, fiducial, selection, normalization and covariance conventions remain required.

limitations: Historical code commit, build/configuration and actual producer/output ancestry remain unknown. Current 2023/2025 code, a repository named Rustico_old or a retrospective Papers where used link cannot fill that gap. The linked old documentation and journal bodies were unavailable; cached arXiv v2 identity is retained.

The paper's 2048 MD-Patchy, 1000 QPM and 20 selection-free halo populations have different roles and cosmologies. Published counts do not identify released files, valid paired IDs, reconstruction status or an independent mock population.

The fixed analysis fiducial model differs from mock-generating cosmologies; AP and fixed spectral-shape/nuisance conditioning must be preserved. No full Planck-species model or native engine defaults are inferred.

Binned P0/P2/B0 covariance is distinct from the later compressed 8x8 RSD/BAO covariance. The latter combines mock correlations with data-fit variance estimates. Shared galaxies/mocks/BAO geometry imply dependence; unknown cross-covariance remains unknown.

The bispectrum window is an approximation that neglects window action on the shape factor; source tests and low-k exclusions are conditional. Actual W2/W3, random/mask support, positive normalization, shot-noise and historical output conventions remain unverified.

Printed grid/boundary, AP k/q/triangle-closure/angular-normalization and compressed-likelihood/diagonal terminology issues remain preserved. No source repair, current-code correction or historical result reproduction is accepted.

Source fσ8 is a fitted summary. The checked σ8(z)=D(z)σ80 relation leaves the complete 8 h^-1 Mpc top-hat/full-k/matter-species definition unresolved and does not admit a finite-band reduced-sector variance under that name.

All current-to-released output adapters, full windows/auto-cross covariance, likelihood/prior/selection/calibration ownership and consumer/numerical/physical gates remain open. Public availability and unknown licences do not grant raw redistribution.
